title: Backend Architecture – Data Pipeline
searchText: backend architecture – data pipeline page page 3fd2137e-c7db-81e2-bb07-c3bcedf6c5ef bluebird labs – project apollo hub 🛠️ 2026-10-18t17:03:15.557z page_last_edited_at (notion-fetch returned no created time or authors) author: **daniel levi** ## overview nightly job imports the greenleaf point-of-sale csv export, cleans it and loads it into postgresql. the dashboard reads from a small rest api. ## components - **importer** – python script, runs at 02:00 every night - **database** – postgresql 16, tables: stores, products, sales, stock_levels - **api** – fastapi, endpoints /sales/daily, /products/top, /stock/alerts ## open questions - how long should raw csv files be kept? (daniel suggests 90 days) - does greenleaf need real-time stock updates? ask sarah kim.
